formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : SimpleGraph (Fin x1)) [x3 : DecidableRel x2.Adj], (∀ (x4 x5 x6 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x4 x5 → x2.Adj x5 x6 → ¬x2.Adj x6 x4) → PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle x2 → ∃ (x6 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.IsMinimalMonoCircuit x1 x6 ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x6 = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun x2 ∅ ∧ ∀ x7 < x6.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x6 x7).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∃ (x10 : Fin x1) (x11 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x10 x11 ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.Owns x1 x6 x7 x10 x11
plain_statement: A graph with no triangle and no 4-cycle. Some least circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, for its edge function has every AND gate owning at least one edge.
title: A step toward: On graphs with no triangle and no 4-cycle, some least AND/OR circuit of fan-in two for the edge function has every AND gate owning a star of edge
